The ADR decides that answerability is a read-time decoration and that respondToRequest enforcement is unchanged by it; the respond path still checks the same answerability before any adapter effect. Classification unchanged.

Merge review (origin/main f287e7538 into #2915/#2916): orchestration-service.ts changed on both sides. The ADR's claims (answerability decorated at read time; respondToRequest still checks it before any adapter effect) hold with both. Classification unchanged.

Integration source review for #2915 on d0ca944c5: orchestration-service.ts and routes/orchestration/orchestration.ts (#2915, owner decision): the command route marks its respondToRequest dispatch with approvalModeAuthority (the route and session authorization a setApprovalMode Auto pick needs); with it, an acceptForSession answer whose grant (toolRequestSessionGrantFromPayload over the open request.opened, read with the standing posture decision before the answer is sent) is edit-mode records an auto session.approval-mode-set after the adapter has taken the answer, through recordApprovalModeDecision based on that earlier decision, so a decision recorded meanwhile refuses it; never over a standing auto or never. The delegated respond path and the approval inbox record nothing, and the inbox card omits the auto-accept action. The respond-to-permission-request row (POST /api/orchestration/commands respondToRequest) still holds; the approval-mode control claims are unaffected. Prose accurate.
